name: Planyard
summary: Cost estimating, bid management and project budgeting with Xero, QuickBooks, MYOB, Sage and Procore sync.
differentiator: Priced per project manager rather than per company or project: $52 (Estimating), $105 (Essential), $158 (Professional) or $210 (Ultimate) per month, with support staff at $43. Subcontractor quoting automation sits in the top tier, so five project managers on Ultimate would pay $1,050 a month before support seats. A 14-day full-access trial needs no card.
pricing: Estimating $52, Essential $105, Professional $158 and Ultimate $210 per month per project manager; supporting staff $43 each; Enterprise custom. 14-day full-access trial, no credit card, and no limit on simultaneous projects.
bestFor: GCs with one or two project managers running many jobs.
skipIf: Your team has many project managers and needs sub quoting automation.
